master.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: clean master character reference for hand-drawn game animation.
Select ONLY character NUMBER 3, the rightmost janitor in the input image. Preserve his original identity: clearly adult fifty-five-year-old man, very stocky rounded body and big belly, broad ruddy face, heavy dark walrus moustache, dark side hair, thick eyebrows, skeptical half-lidded eyes, worn navy knitted beanie with a small repaired patch, short thick legs and black rubber work boots. Keep the flat South Park cut-paper cartoon art style. Do not include the other two men.

Create a single reference sheet showing TWO full-body poses of this SAME man, equal scale and same foot baseline: CLOSED COAT on the left, COAT OPEN DISPLAYING MERCHANDISE on the right. Isolated sprites with genuine transparent background. Leave generous empty spacing and padding around each figure, including the outstretched coat. No bathroom backdrop, no captions or number circles.

WARDROBE REDESIGN REQUESTED BY THE USER:
Replace his short hooded olive jacket with a LONG JANITOR'S WORK COAT used by the casino ROYAL. It is a straight loose housekeeping duster/smock that reaches the knees, visibly long rather than a jacket. Faded deep burgundy fabric, simple folded collar, long sleeves with worn cuffs, a row of plain brass-colored buttons, two large square utility pockets, modest cream piping at the collar. Add a small CREAM CHEST PATCH with a GOLD CROWN and the exact readable text "ROYAL" on the wearer's left chest. Functional modest casino housekeeping uniform, stained near the lower hem. No hood or drawstrings.
Under the work coat he wears the selected baggy old ivory-and-faded-blue striped cotton boxer shorts, mismatched sewn repair patches and dirt smudges, with a secure elastic waist and two roomy short legs. Preserve the neutral humorous round cartoon belly, bare lower legs and boots from the selected reference. His clothes stay intact and opaque where they cover his body.

LEFT POSE: coat buttoned closed, hands resting in the deep side pockets, feet firmly planted, deadpan suspicious expression. The shorts are naturally hidden by the long closed coat. Show a small bare lower-leg area above the boots.
RIGHT POSE: both hands hold the lapels open as a shopkeeper displaying goods sewn inside the lining. Three toilet-paper rolls and two wrapped soaps are attached inside the left panel; a yellow sponge, three little shampoo bottles and a chewing-gum pack inside the right panel. Keep the merchandise arranged in large readable flat shapes. The ROYAL patch remains attached to the outside of the coat panel. Same height, same face, same hat, same body and foot locations as the closed pose. Front-facing neutral game-sprite stance.
Keep silhouettes simple, limbs clean and consistent, no realistic shading or 3D perspective.

atlas.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: DRAWN 2D GAME ANIMATION SPRITE SHEET.
Use the attached two-pose master as the EXACT character and wardrobe reference. Preserve the same clearly adult stocky moustached man, patched navy beanie, ruddy cheeks, skeptical eyebrows, black boots, long burgundy ROYAL janitor work coat with cream piping and small gold crown patch, and patched worn striped boxer shorts in the selling pose. Match the face and coat design exactly. This is the same stationary janitor merchant in every frame.

Create ONE REGULAR 4-COLUMN BY 4-ROW SPRITE SHEET, SIXTEEN complete full-body drawn frames, arranged in strict row-major order, on a GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background. Prefer a square canvas. Divide the canvas into exactly 16 equal rectangular cells. Every cell contains exactly one entire character, with generous clear padding. No frame labels, no numbers, no captions, no grid lines, no props outside the character. Keep every sprite at exactly the same height and scale, centered on the same local vertical axis, with BOTH BOOT SOLES on the SAME baseline within every cell. The character never steps or changes floor position. All hands and the widest opened coat fit inside their cell. These are sprite frames for animation playback, not a decorative illustrated montage.

ROW 1: STANDING IDLE, COAT CLOSED, FOUR FRAMES.
1: neutral face, eyes forward, both hands in the large coat pockets.
2: very slight breathing lift of the shoulders, same face and planted feet.
3: brief blink with both eyelids closed, otherwise unchanged.
4: eyes open again, relaxed neutral stance.
Coat stays long, buttoned and closed in all four.

ROW 2: LOOKING AROUND, COAT CLOSED, FOUR FRAMES.
1: eyes and head glance slightly LEFT, body and feet remain forward and stationary.
2: head and eyes return to FRONT.
3: eyes and head glance slightly RIGHT, same body anchor.
4: head and eyes return to FRONT.
Keep the same recognizable front-face proportions, with only a restrained head turn.

ROW 3: QUIETLY BECKONING A CUSTOMER, COAT CLOSED, FOUR FRAMES.
He uses his LEFT ARM (on the viewer's RIGHT) to beckon, while the other hand stays in its coat pocket. This is a normal friendly shopkeeper's "come here" gesture.
1: beckoning forearm extends a little to the side, palm up.
2: the same hand curls inward toward the chest with bent fingers.
3: the same hand extends outward again, palm up.
4: the same hand curls inward once more.
Distinct readable hand and forearm positions, one natural arm per side, no extra hands. Feet and lower body fixed.

ROW 4: OPENING THE COAT TO SHOW THE SHOP, FOUR FRAMES.
1: both hands have come out of the pockets and grip the lapels, coat still closed.
2: both coat panels open one quarter, beginning to reveal the lining pockets.
3: both panels open halfway, clearly showing the fixed merchandise and the patched opaque shorts.
4: both hands hold the coat fully open, EXACTLY matching the right-hand master pose.
Three paper rolls and two wrapped soaps remain sewn into the left lining panel. The sponge, three small bottles and gum remain sewn into the right lining panel. They move WITH the opening coat, in a consistent arrangement. The crown-and-ROYAL patch remains on the coat's outside.
The man wears the same opaque roomy mid-thigh patched striped cotton boxer shorts beneath his work coat throughout. In closed-coat frames they are hidden naturally, with short bare lower legs above the boots. In the selling frames keep the same ordinary neutral cartoon torso and belly as the master. These are non-dramatic original game NPC shopkeeper sprites.

Flat South Park cut-paper cartoon shapes, crisp outlines and the master's colors. No 3D, no perspective, no background scene, no floor shadows, no text beyond the small ROYAL patch on the coat.
